en.headline: Hiker injured by monkey at Shing Mun Reservoir
en.dek: Police were called at 11:16am after a woman in her 30s was hurt on the hand while hiking near Pineapple Dam and taken to Yan Chai Hospital.
body: A woman in her 30s was injured on the hand by a wild monkey while hiking near Pineapple Dam at Shing Mun Reservoir in Tsuen Wan on Sunday morning, and was taken to Yan Chai Hospital conscious, according to reports of the police call.

HK01 and Wen Wei Po reported that police received the report at 11:16am. Rescuers attended and the woman, whose hand was bleeding, was sent to hospital. HK01 described the injury as a bite; Wen Wei Po described it as a scratch. She was reported to be conscious.
The reports did not name the woman. No further official account of her condition was available on Sunday afternoon.

zh.headline: 城門水塘行山女子遭猴子傷手送院
zh.dek: 警方上午11時16分接報，一名30餘歲女子在菠蘿壩附近行山時手部受傷流血，清醒送往仁濟醫院。
body: 星期日上午，一名30餘歲女子在荃灣城門水塘近菠蘿壩行山期間，遭野生猴子弄傷手部並流血，清醒由救護車送往仁濟醫院。
《香港01》及《文匯報》報道，警方於上午11時16分接報，救援人員到場處理。兩份報道對傷勢描述不一，《香港01》指她被咬傷，《文匯報》指她被抓傷。她當時清醒。
報道沒有公布女子姓名。截至星期日下午，未見當局再公布她的情況。
